title: Resident FLINT fmpz exact backend witness
objective: Implement and qualify the smallest source-transparent compiler slice that represents resident exact integer-vector state with FLINT fmpz values, including promoted arithmetic, Python floor division and remainder, and direct fmpz matrix entry round trips without hot-loop mpz conversion

oracles: same-source generated JavaScript and existing GMP exact backend differential execution
generated C structural inspection and FLINT promotion-boundary cases

handoff.summary: Added a deliberately narrow internal FLINT fmpz backend for closed exact-arena programs. Qualified `arena.integer_vector(capacity, 0)` stores inline-promoting `fmpz` values, performs promoted scalar/vector arithmetic with Python floor division and remainder, and passes exact values directly through fmpz matrix entry calls. The ordinary public ABI converts once at entry and exit; explicit tagged, GMP, and same-source JavaScript implementations remain available as differential oracles. Generated-C evidence proves the resident vector has no per-entry `mpz_init` and the selected internal function contains no `mpz_*` operation or fmpz/mpz bridge.
risks: The backend is intentionally fail-closed outside one arena, unbounded vectors, uint64 indices, Integer results, and the three direct fmpz matrix declarations; the cubic root therefore remains on GMP.

Repository-wide `pnpm architecture:check` reaches all native/package/Wasm checks but fails the optimizer-opportunity manifest freshness check already inherited from the integration base; that merge-owned census must be regenerated after compiler lanes land.

`pnpm test:native` passed every correctness, FFI, sanitizer, compiler, and production-pack stage, then failed only the unrelated final dense-QQ performance budget under shared-container load (`select_rows_300`, `select_columns_300`, and `stack_300x300`).
next_steps: Teach the fmpz emitter to lower a closed native call graph with bool and tuple results, preserving direct fmpz arguments across helper calls.
Add a resident fmpz import/view for IntegerBuffer parameters so the cubic root does not perform an mpz/fmpz conversion on every buffer access.

Qualify `uint64.from_integer_checked` and the cubic root's remaining twelve FFI declarations, then require generated-C evidence that the complete root has no mpz operations in its hot region before enabling selection.
